prompt: Put a new action release in order, from code to consumers.
explanation: Ship in order: merge, test what you merged, reconcile the metadata, then cut tags and point the listing at them. Consumers pin the tags — so the tags are the last thing you touch, after everything they refer to is true.

options.text: Land the change on the action’s default branch
Run the action’s test workflows against that ref
Update `action.yml` if inputs, outputs, or branding changed
Tag the release — the version tag, plus the moving major tag
Publish or update the Marketplace listing pointing at the tag
